metricDefinitions.minimumCredits: Minimum observed across every five-second simulation step.
metricDefinitions.removedPieces: Construction anchors in accepted demolition orders, counting a machine once regardless of its size. Current strategies must preserve belts during machine changes.
metricDefinitions.componentWaitSeconds: Sum of reported warning durations across components. Concurrent waits overlap. Deliberate batch completion and manual pauses are excluded. This is not world downtime.
metricDefinitions.componentWaits: Warning transitions persisting at least thirty simulation seconds.

scope: Two reproducible independent worlds (seeds strate-profile-regression/0 and /1), eight simulated hours each, four distinct agents, ordinary initial stock/costs and physical cargo. Not live-player UX or production capacity proof.
